intake.duplicate_effort: none from AMD-Ecosystem/ROCm, but upstream's own default OpenCL backend already runs on AMD/Intel/NVIDIA GPUs -- functionally already-supported
intake.summary: Java-to-GPU JIT compiler (OpenCL/CUDA-PTX/Metal/CPU backends); AMD is already reachable via its own default OpenCL backend, and the CUDA-only slice (PTX codegen + NVIDIA library JNI bindings) is a compiler code-generation target, not CUDA kernels to hipify.
